description: [Ncloud Storage] ⚠️ Destructive: Delete multiple objects (optionally specific versions) from a Ncloud Storage bucket in one call (POST /?delete). Give plain keys or objects with versionId. Returns per-key results (deleted / errors) — the call is HTTP 200 even when some keys fail. Set confirm=true to execute.

bucketName.description: Name of the Ncloud Storage bucket

bypassGovernanceRetention.description: Send x-amz-bypass-governance-retention: true for objects under GOVERNANCE retention

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute the destructive operation

expectedBucketOwner.description: x-amz-expected-bucket-owner — expected owner account number of the bucket: the account number inside any resource NRN (nrn:PUB:<service>:<region>:<accountNo>:…, e.g. from ncloud_resource_list_resources). The 36-char owner ID from ncloud_ncs_list_buckets is rejected as InvalidBucketOwnerAWSAccountID. A different owner is rejected with AccessDenied (403)

keys.description: Object keys to delete (current versions). Use `objects` instead to target versions

objects.description: Objects to delete, each optionally with a versionId and an ETag condition

etag.description: Conditional delete: delete only if the current ETag equals this value, or '*' to delete only if the object exists. A failed condition is reported for that key as PreconditionFailed while the call still returns 200

quiet.description: Quiet mode — the response lists only failures

name: ncloud_ncs_delete_objects
